metadata.description: Biographical fact item pool for the Trust Paradigm. Contains items for face domains (holiday, name) and object domains (object_material, object_origin). Item IDs match the assignments in counterbalancing.json.
metadata.task_format: 2-AFC: one target fact (correct for this stimulus) vs. one foil fact (belongs to a different stimulus, same domain)

H1.question_DE: Wer war in Italien im Urlaub?

H2.question_DE: Wer war in Portugal im Urlaub?

H3.question_DE: Wer war in Schottland im Urlaub?

name.note: Sex-specific: _m fields for male participants (face_01=Paul, face_02=Luis, face_03=Max), _f fields for female participants (face_01=Martha, face_02=Lena, face_03=Anna).

object_material.note: Concrete physical property — easy to learn and clearly distinguishable in 2-AFC.

object_origin.note: Real country of origin — concrete and easy to learn.

design_notes.item_assignment_faces: Which face gets which item is determined at runtime via counterbalancing.json (face_assignments, domains: holiday, name).
design_notes.item_assignment_objects: Which object gets which item is determined at runtime via counterbalancing.json (object_assignments, domains: object_material, object_origin).
design_notes.foil_selection: During the 2-AFC learning phase, the foil is always the item assigned to a different stimulus (face or object) within the same domain and CB group.
design_notes.question_format_faces: question_DE is shown; participant selects which of two faces the fact belongs to.
design_notes.question_format_objects: question_DE is shown; participant selects which of two objects the fact belongs to.
